Wolf_Red.label: Terminology: 'loup rouge' (Canis rufus) chosen over 'loup roux'. Plural 'loups rouges', puppy 'louveteau rouge'.
RedWolfMorph.label: Terminology: 'morphe de loup rouge'. Pawnmorpher ships no French, so 'morph' = 'morphe' is my choice.
RedwolfmorphConservationVolunteerGeneral: Three-segment switch {PAWN_gender ? il : elle : al} for the subject pronoun (al system). 'a été volontaire pour se faire transformer' chosen so no participle has to agree. 'monde intermédiaire' translates 'Midworld': term not checked against the game's French. Unverified that the game resolves the switch in a backstory description.
RedwolfmorphConservationForcedGeneral.ba: Agreeing participles (retrouvé, transformé) written as three-segment switches, neutral forms in -æ. Unverified that the game resolves the switch in a backstory description.
RedwolfmorphConservationForcedGeneral.ti: English is 'red wolf of wall street' (a pun on a film title): kept as a reference.
Switch for 'content' (agrees with the colonist). Thought text is first person: unverified that the game supplies the pawn gender in a thought description.
Switch for 'mignon' (agrees with the colonist). Same unverified point on thought descriptions.
RedWolfTransformationMemory.stages.chang: Switch for 'censé' (agrees with the colonist). Same unverified point on thought descriptions.
English addresses the body ('how I missed you'); written in the third person so that no 'tu' appears.
RedWolfTailMemory.stages.Wolf_tail-3.des: English says 'Look at it wag': imperative addressing a reader, rewritten as a statement so that no vous or tu appears.
EtherRedWolfMuzzle.stagePatches.21.value: stagePatches keys are numeric: the child's four patches are appended to the parent's list (21 in Pawnmorpher's WolfJawBase). If Pawnmorpher changes that list, the index shifts and a French text lands on the wrong stage. Not seen in game.
EtherRedWolfEar.stagePatches.6.values.de: Numeric index, same caveat as the muzzle (6 inherited patches).
EtherRedWolfTail.stagePatches.6.values.d: Numeric index, same caveat as the muzzle (6 inherited patches).
EtherRedWolfEye.stagePatches.2.values.de: Numeric index, same caveat as the muzzle (2 inherited patches).
